children.name: Thesium hirtum  Zhigila, Verboom & Muasya
children.description: 5.2.2.3.3. Conservation status. Thesium hirtum has been designated LC (Least Concerned) status (Raimondo et al., 2009; Von Staden, 2015) as species are found in Nature Reserves across its range. Our assessment supports this status. However, with current stochastic events of recurrent fires in Western Cape, plant populations with poor post-fire regeneration such as T. hirtum might be negatively impacted and threatened (Bond and van Wilgen, 1996), and need to be monitored.
